usageNotes: Use this to update an existing webhook notification endpoint in the cluster — change its URL, HTTP method, headers, secrets, or toggle it on/off without recreating it. Requires 'Mapping.Modify' on '/mapping/notifications' plus either 'Sys.Modify'/'Sys.Audit' or 'Sys.AccessNetwork' on '/'. Supply the 'digest' field (from the GET response) to guard against concurrent edits; omit it only if race conditions are acceptable.

examples.summary: Update the target URL and re-enable a previously disabled webhook endpoint

tips: Header values and secret values must be base64-encoded before being passed in the 'header' and 'secret' arrays, formatted as 'name=<name>,value=<base64>'.
Use the 'delete' array to remove individual optional fields (e.g. 'body', 'comment') rather than overwriting them with empty strings.
Fetch the current config with get_cluster_notifications_endpoints_webhook_name first to obtain a fresh 'digest' before submitting updates.
Returns null on success; any HTTP error indicates the config was not applied.
